chunks: Jibril, peace be upon him, descended with a tool from Paradise; and it has also been narrated: with a red ruby. Then he passed it around Adam’s head and shaved his head with it.

key_terms.آدَمَ: Adam, upon whom this act was performed
key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise, the heavenly source of the instrument
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلُ: Jibril, the angel who descended with the instrument
key_terms.حَلَقَ: he shaved, referring to the act of shaving the head
key_terms.رَأْسِ: the head, referring to Adam’s head
key_terms.يَاقُوتَةٍ: a ruby, given here as an alternative description of the object

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about Jibril عليه السلام shaving Adam’s head during the origin of hajj rites?
ai.summary: This narration describes Jibril عليه السلام descending with an instrument from Paradise, alternatively described as a red ruby, and using it to shave the head of Adam. In the context of the virtues of hajj, it reflects an origin narrative connected to ritual practice.
